mentions.name: Valori
mentions.description: A Python-native vector database built as modular, hackable building blocks for embeddings, covering storage, indexing, and quantization. It lets users plug in their own models and search pipelines without touching C++.
mentions.problem: Customizing vector databases typically requires working in C++.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building Valori, a Python-native vector database.
It’s basically Lego blocks for embeddings: storage, indexing, quantization — all modular, all hackable.
The goal? Let anyone plug in their own models and search pipelines without touching C++.
